#!/usr/bin/env tclsh
package require Tcl 8.6
namespace eval robot {
    variable pos {0 0}
    proc move {cmds} {
        variable pos
        foreach c [split $cmds ""] {
            switch -- $c {
                A { lset pos 1 [expr {[lindex $pos 1] + 1}] }
                L - R { }
                default { error "bad $c" }
            }
        }
        return $pos
    }
}
puts [robot::move "AA"]
dict set d a 1; if {[dict get $d a] > 0 && ![string is space "x"]} { puts "ok" }
